description:
AI Agent skills help you turn a successful workflow into a repeatable method without flattening the judgment that still needs a human.
Use the seven-field template to define the trigger, context, decisions, output, checks, and revision evidence.

What you'll learn:
- How to identify work that is actually repeatable
- How to write an AI Agent skill as an inspectable decision path
- How to test and improve a reusable workflow

Follow Tiny Agent. Tiny Agent helps you get better at using AI.
